howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.intro: Guinea Pig Monitor looks after your guinea pigs' health while you are not watching. This is how it works, step by step.

mark.title: Each guinea pig wears a color mark
mark.text: You register each guinea pig with its name, its breed and the color of the mark on its back. That color is how it is recognized.

watch.title: The cage watches and listens
watch.text: A camera watches the guinea pigs, a microphone listens for squeals and a scale weighs the cage.

analyse.title: Artificial intelligence analyses it
analyse.text: Every minute, an Amazon Bedrock vision model measures how much each guinea pig moves and how often it visits the feeder, and sends it to the system.

panel.title: You see it on the dashboard
panel.text: Here you see the status of each guinea pig and the alerts. When you take care of one, mark it as reviewed.

common.refreshHint: The data refreshes by itself every 30 seconds; tap to do it now

register.title: Register a guinea pig
register.intro: Add its photo and choose its mark. While you fill in the form you see how its card will look.
register.markText: It is the color on its back. The camera recognizes it by that color, so each guinea pig wears a different one.

register.notesPlaceholder: Temperament, allergies, where it comes from…

register.previewEmpty: Fill in the details and they show up here.

delete.title: Remove {{name}}?
delete.text: It will no longer show in your cage and its mark color will be free for another guinea pig. Its history is kept.

auth.tagline: Look after your guinea pigs in time

hero.title: Your guinea pigs, always in sight
hero.point1: Know right away if a guinea pig is not well
hero.point2: Live alerts, without reloading the page
hero.point3: History and weight of your cage in one place

assistant.name: Cuchi
assistant.title: Cuchi, your helper
assistant.subtitle: I explain the app and how your guinea pigs are
assistant.greeting: Hi! I'm Cuchi. Ask me what a state means, what to do about an alert or how to use the app.
assistant.disclaimer: Cuchi is not a vet. If a guinea pig is on alert or critical, check it and see a vet.

suggestion.register: How do I register a guinea pig?

error.unavailable: Cuchi can't answer right now. Try again in a few minutes.

admin.subtitle: What breeders pick from in the app comes from here, not from the code.
admin.notAllowed: This section is for admins only.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.intro: The breeds and colors offered when a guinea pig is registered. You can add the missing ones without waiting for a new version of the app.
catalog.label: Name
catalog.labelHint: What the breeder will read, for example “Colombian guinea pig”.
catalog.codeHint: Built from the name. It is what gets stored on every guinea pig, so it does not change later.
catalog.codeInvalid: A code can only hold letters, numbers and _, up to 20 characters.
catalog.codeTaken: An option with that code is already in this list.
catalog.added: Done, “{{label}}” is in the list now.
catalog.saveFailed: We could not save it. Please try again.
catalog.turnOffExplain: It will stop being offered when a guinea pig is registered. The guinea pigs that already have it keep it, and you can show it again whenever you want.
catalog.turnedOff: “{{label}}” is no longer in the list.
catalog.turnOffFailed: We could not hide it. Please try again.

users.title: Accounts
users.intro: Who gets into the app, and who can edit the catalog.
users.lastAdmin: This is the only admin: name another one before changing it.
users.promoteExplain: They will be able to edit the catalog and the accounts, just like you.
users.demoteExplain: They keep using their cages as usual, but can no longer edit the catalog.
users.enableExplain: They will be able to sign in again.
users.disableExplain: They will not be able to sign in. Their cages and guinea pigs are not deleted, and you can enable the account again.
users.failed: We could not apply the change. Please try again.
